opportunities.title: Patch Now: Citrix NetScaler's Dual Zero-Days (CVE-2026-88772) Are a Pre-Auth Root Party — Custom Malware Already Inside Govt, Banks, and Law Firms
opportunities.why_now: Four separate outlets are reporting active exploitation of the same NetScaler zero-days with named payloads (WHIPSHOT, SLAPSHOT) hitting critical sectors right now.
opportunities.angle: Rapid-response CVE breakdown: exploit chain, IOCs, who's been hit, and a hard patch deadline — the exact 'inevitable breach' digest format.

opportunities.title: Spectre Won't Die: New BTR Variant Leaks Linux Memory Through JIT Engines on Intel, AMD, and Arm
opportunities.why_now: Multiple outlets confirm a fresh Spectre v2 variant defeating existing CPU mitigations across all major vendors simultaneously.
opportunities.angle: Explainer on why hardware speculative-execution bugs keep resurrecting and what (if anything) sysadmins can actually do about it — patch cadence angle since silicon can't be 'patched' the normal way.

opportunities.title: ShinyHunters vs. the FBI: A Threat Actor That Won't Take the Off-Ramp
opportunities.why_now: The FBI publicly called on ShinyHunters members to surrender, the group publicly refused, and Dutch police just arrested a 'reformed' member connected to the crew — three angles converging in 48 hours.
opportunities.angle: Threat-actor profile / timeline piece tracking the group's arrests, defiance, and what it signals about extradition-era hacker culture.

opportunities.title: Apple's CoreGraphics Zero-Day Was Being Exploited Before the Patch Existed — Update Now
opportunities.why_now: Apple shipped an emergency fix for a CoreGraphics flaw already weaponized in targeted attacks, confirmed by two independent outlets.
opportunities.angle: Tight patch-cadence alert: what CoreGraphics touches, who's likely targeted (given 'targeted attacks' framing), and update urgency for iOS/macOS fleets.

opportunities.title: JadePuffer Hijacked Azure Identities Just to Blow Things Up — Meet the Cloud Attacker That Skips the Ransomware Step
opportunities.why_now: Two outlets are covering this destructive Azure identity-hijacking campaign, and it breaks the usual ransomware/exfiltration playbook by going straight to sabotage.
opportunities.angle: Threat-actor deep dive on the TTPs (identity hijack → resource destruction) as a new category of cloud attack worth adding to IR runbooks.
